# awscc_transcribe_medical_vocabulary (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Transcribe::MedicalVocabulary



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the medical vocabulary.
- `language_code` (String) The language code of the vocabulary entries.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags associated with the medical vocabulary. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `vocabulary_file_uri` (String) The Amazon S3 location of the text file that contains the medical vocabulary.
- `vocabulary_name` (String) The name of the medical vocabulary.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.
